content.content:
| 675 | the compiled class loader makes a size computed at instantiation beyond its kind: with `next[\nat k\](): ZZ64 = sz64[\k + 1\](Box[\k + 1\](0))`, `next[\4294967295\]()` answers 4294967296, where walk refuses a `nat` above 4294967295 when it binds it | NEGATIVE-VERIFIED | implementation gap (runtime) | `basic/trait-parameters.tex`, "Nat and Int Parameters" | `ProjectFortress/compiler_tests/NatArithBeyondRun.test` | climb batch 13 rung N | `Naming.foldSize` (`ProjectFortress/src/com/sun/fortress/runtimeSystem/Naming.java:1234-1253` at 9d323883f) computes exactly and checks no kind: a `nat` and an `int` share one spelling (`compiler/NamingCzar.java:1829-1833`). The checker checks a size folded from numerals (`XXXNatArithRangeChecker`) but not one computed from static parameters. The test asserts today's value and turns red on a fix. A power it does not compute, `Box[\2^k\]` at k = 5000, stops the run with NumberFormatException. Walk: `interpreter/evaluator/EvalType.java:256-273`. |
| 681 | the compiled checker infers no static argument written with a static parameter in it: in `pred[\int i\](): ZZ32 = get(IBox[\i - 1\](0))` the call of `get[\int i\](b: IBox[\i\])` is refused, 'is not applicable to an argument of type IBox[\i-1\]', where `get[\i - 1\]` written is accepted | NEGATIVE-VERIFIED | implementation gap (checker) | `basic/inference.tex`, "The Static Arguments of a Call" | `ProjectFortress/compiler_tests/XXXNatArithInferChecker.test` | climb batch 13 rung N's skeptic | `Formula.isNatTerm` (`ProjectFortress/src/com/sun/fortress/scala_src/typechecker/Formula.scala:155` at 7dd0adf0c) lets a size inference variable bind a static parameter or a numeral only, so `$i = i-1` has no solution; the identity sentence (`basic/types-vals-vars.tex`, "Types") makes `IBox[\$i\]` and `IBox[\i-1\]` the same type once `$i` is `i-1`. Workaround: write the static argument. Walk runs it: `pred[\0\]()` is -1. No site of the library needs it. |

# The library

The library is `Library/` and `ProjectFortress/LibraryBuiltin/`, without the compiler's own files there:

- In `Library/`: the interpreter's prelude, `FortressLibrary.fss` and `.fsi`, and its other components. The compiler's `CompilerLibrary`, `CompilerAlgebra` and `CompilerSystem` are not part of it. `FortressAst.fss` and `.fsi` are generated from `ProjectFortress/astgen/Fortress.ast`: edit that file, never these two.
188:| trait types, object-expression types | `basic/types-vals-vars.tex:192`, `:226` | `Type.rats:377` `TraitType`, `:29` `Type` | `types/TypeAnalyzer.scala`, `TypeSchemaAnalyzer.scala`, `TypeHierarchyChecker.scala` | `evaluator/EvalType.java`, `types/FTypeTrait.java` | `NamingCzar.java` (trait → JVM interface) | `AnyType.fsi` | works (both) | — |
235:| dimension and unit parameters | `basic/trait-parameters.tex:122` | `MayNewlineHeader.rats:191` `UnitConstraint`, `:381` `UnitExpr` | `STypesUtil.scala:552`, `:556` `NI.nyi()` | `EvalType` has no case: `Can't EvalType this node type … TaggedDimType` | — | none | absent on both | 26, 27 |
295:| `dim` / `unit` declarations | `basic/dimensions.tex`; `advanced/defining-dimensions.tex:32`, `:94` | `OtherDecl.rats:35` `DimUnitDecl` | `IndexBuilder.scala:184-185` builds them, then `STypesUtil.scala:552`, `:556` `NI.nyi()` on the kinds | `BuildEnvironments.forDimUnitDecl:996` — a stub returning `false`; `EvalType` has no `TaggedDimType` case | no `forDimDecl`/`forUnitDecl` | none | absent on both | 26, 27 |
383:`Driver.runProgram` creates the ForkJoin pool (`FortressTaskRunnerGroup`, sized by `FORTRESS_THREADS`, `:521-532,556`), registers the program arguments, and invokes an `EvaluatorTask` (`:554-570`), which calls back into `Driver.runProgramTask` (`interpreter/evaluator/tasks/EvaluatorTask.java:46`) to look up the `run` closure and invoke it (`Driver.java:501-513`).
397:For apis that were synthesized from `import java`, the same phase asks `ForeignJava` to generate wrappers (`CodeGenerationPhase.java:94`, `repository/ForeignJava.java:757,807` → `compiler/nativeInterface/FortressTransformer.java:37`), which writes them into `nativewrapper_cache` (`FortressTransformer.java:33`).
411:Analysis results are serialized as text: `ASTIO.writeJavaAst` writes a parenthesized dump of the node tree (`nodes_util/ASTIO.java:92-120`) and `FortressNodeReader`/`Unprinter`/`interpreter/reader/Lex` read it back (`ASTIO.java:142-160`).
433:Tasks: a compiled program's entry class extends `FortressExecutable`, whose static initializer creates one `FortressTaskRunnerGroup` sized by `FORTRESS_THREADS`, with a spawn threshold and loop chunk read from the environment (`runtimeSystem/FortressExecutable.java:22-56`).
449:Compiler: a `.fss` writes `import java com.sun.fortress.nativeHelpers.{class.method => name, …}` (16 such lines in `LibraryBuiltin/CompilerBuiltin.fss`, 3 in `Library/CompilerLibrary.fss`); `ForeignJava` reads the Java class with ASM to synthesize an api for it (`repository/ForeignJava.java:132-136,565-575`), and `FortressTransformer` rewrites the class into a wrapper whose methods take and return the compiled world's boxed values (`compiler/nativeInterface/FortressTransformer.java:37`, wrapper written to `nativewrapper_cache` at `:33`).
451:`import java` also works on the interpreter path, by a third route that is easy to miss: `ForeignComponentWrapper` populates an environment from `ForeignJava`'s synthesized declarations (`interpreter/env/ForeignComponentWrapper.java:59`), and `ClosureMaker` generates, at run time, a `NativeFn<n>` subclass that calls the Java method and writes it into `bytecode_cache` (`interpreter/env/ClosureMaker.java:44-50,52`).
